welcome-sub: Gedhi reKusimbaradza Africa kuburikidza nePi Ecosystem
africa-day: (Mukupemberera Zuva reAfrica re25, chirongwa ichi chekudzidzisa Pi Pioneers chatangwa)
intro-p1: Pi Network imari yedhijitari uye chirongwa chepasi rose chakagadzirirwa kuita kuti cryptocurrency iwanikwe uye ibatsire munhu wese.
intro-p2: Kusiyana nemamwe macryptocurrency anoda michina inodhura yemigodhi, Pi Network inobvumira vanhuwo zvavo kutora chikamu zvakananga kubva kumafoni avo.
intro-list:
• Vakai hupfumi hwedhijitari hunobatanidza munhu wese
  • Simbisai vanhuwo zvavo pasirese
  • Wedzerai kushandiswa kwezuva nezuva
  • Tsigirai kutengeserana kwevanhu
ch1-p2: Nhanho 2: Nyoresa neFacebook kana Foni → Isa kodhi: CHIGALEX1 → Tora mubairo we1 Pi
ch1-p3: Kuchera Kwemazuva Ese: Dzoka maawa 24 oga oga wodzvanya bhatani remheni kuti uenderere mberi nekuchera.
ch1-list:
• Gadzira Pi wallet zvakachengeteka
  • Pedzisa 2FA
  • Pedzisa KYC
  • Gadzirira Mainnet migration
security-msg: ⚠️ Chengetedzo yeWallet: Usambofa wakagovana mazwi ako 24 epassphrase! Chikwata chePi Core hachife chakakukumbira!
ch2-p1: Pi Wallet yako ibhangi rako muPi Ecosystem. Inochengeta mari yako yePi zvakachengeteka pa blockchain.
ch2-p2: Maitiro ekugadzira: Vhura Pi Browser → Wallet → Gadzira Wallet → COPY mazwi ako 24 → Chengeta offline munzvimbo 2 dzakachengeteka.
ch2-p3: Kugamuchira Pi: Govera kero yako yeruzhinji (inotanga na G...). Kutumira Pi: Namatidza kero yeanogamuchira, isa huwandu, simbisa.
ch2a-p1: Zvinoshanda: Tanga nemari diki yekuyedza (1 Pi). Tarisa kuti kero inotanga ne yekupedzisira inofananidzwa. Usambofa wakaisa passphrase pane chero webhusaiti!
ch3-p1: Pi Browser yakafanana neGoogle Play Store yePi. DApps zvirongwa zvakatemerwa zvekushandiswa chaiko — kutenga, dzidzo, mitambo, masevhisi ese achishandisa Pi.
ch4-p1: Tsvaga mabhizinesi anogamuchira Pi pasirese pa mapofpi.com. Nyoresa bhizinesi rako wotanga kugamuchira Pi yezvinhu nemasevhisi.
ch5-p1: Global Consensus Value (GCV) inokurudzira kushandiswa chaiko. 1 Pi = $314,159 GCV. Kukosha uku kunovakwa nemapiyona vachishandisa Pi mukutengeserana chaiko.
ch6-p1: Dzidza bhuku raDoris Yin rekugadzira utility uye kukura kweecosystem. Tsvagiridza, dzidza, uye dzidzisa vamwe — ndiko kusimbaradza Africa.
final-msg: Africa ine mukana wekuve imwe yenzvimbo dzakasimba mukushandiswa kunoshanda mukati mePi Ecosystem. Pamwe Chete Tinovaka. Pamwe Chete Tinodzidzisa.
